selection_manifest_status: No pre-existing citation selection manifest found in recursive main branch tree. This pilot records its own exact six-document selection.
selection_method: Inspected content from 8 of 20 actual PDFs via PyMuPDF text, page metadata, and rendered page images; selected 6 PDFs and 8 cases.
page_number_rule: pdf_page_number_1_based is the physical page in the original PDF. printed_page_label may differ and is informational.
quote_rules: For extractable text, exact_supporting_passage is a verbatim substring of PyMuPDF page.get_text('text',sort=True), and pages were visually checked. For image-only or noisy OCR, text is explicitly marked visual transcription requiring review.
verdict_policy: Cite precise claim, entity, time period, and table coordinate. Valid-looking incorrect passages are negatives even when topic, row label, or header matches.

cases.question: What was Tata Motors Group's consolidated revenue from operations for Q3 FY25 (quarter ended December 31, 2024)?

accepted_evidence.region: Financials table, Revenue from operations row, far-right Consolidated column

rejected_evidence.why_rejected: Page 46 is the Q3 FY24 quarter ended December 31, 2023, not Q3 FY25. The identical row label and table structure do not make its 1,10,577 value support the 2024 quarter claim.

claim_support.pass_rule: The cited span and its table/form context support this exact claim, including entity, period, units, row/column, and qualifiers. A matching heading or number alone is insufficient.

accepted_locations.region: Financials table, Revenue from operations row, far-right Consolidated column

open_and_highlight.pass_rule: Opening the citation reaches an accepted source page and the highlight overlaps the supporting text or table cell, not only a nearby heading or decoy.

color_interpretation.rule: Record the chip color as an observation. Green can mean the text was found on that page; it does not prove claim support. A green citation to rejected_evidence still fails claim_support.
